impact_scope.description: S1 introduces the public LZMA decoder implementing base.io_transformer, with decoder.transform_io as the caller-visible decoding entry point.

evidence: S0 has no matching LZMA decoder declaration, so this newly introduced public decoder has no S0 exposure obligation.
S1 declares public decoder.transform_io(dst, src, workbuf), which accepts LZMA input and drives the new decoder.
H0 enables and invokes only JSON modules and JSON decoder paths; it neither enables the LZMA module nor constructs or calls the LZMA decoder.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add an LZMA decoding entry/call path, including enabling the LZMA module and supplying decoder input, output, and work-buffer arguments; none of these actions was required for this absent unit in S0.
evidence: The S1 public entry point is decoder.transform_io(dst, src, workbuf).
H0's compile-time module configuration lists AUX BASE, AUX JSON, BASE, and JSON only, and all decoding calls target JSON.

reason: The anchored public LZMA decoder is absent in S0 and introduced in S1. Its caller-visible transform_io path is not exposed by unchanged H0, producing the false-to-true gap transition classified as NEW.
